caseNameFull: CARTER, PUBLIC VEHICLE LICENSE COMMISSIONER OF CHICAGO v. MILLER
attorneys: William R. Quinlan argued the cause for petitioner. With him on the briefs were Daniel Pascóle and Robert Retke., Robert Masur argued the cause for respondent. With him on the briefs were Alan Freedman, Howard Eglit, and David Goldberger.*

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
